Get colours from a character's palette

Source: R/palettes.R
tf_palette.Rd

Returns n colours from the named character's palette, either the first n curated colours (type = "discrete") or n colours interpolated across the whole palette (type = "continuous").

Usage

tf_palette(
  name,
  n = NULL,
  type = c("discrete", "continuous"),
  strict = TRUE,
  sort = FALSE,
  medium = "toy"
)

Arguments

name

Palette name. Case-insensitive, and spaces or hyphens may stand in for underscores, so "Optimus Prime" and "Hun-Gurrr" work. See tf_palette_names(). A full name with a medium suffix ("megatron_cartoon") also works and takes precedence over medium.

n

Number of colours wanted. Defaults to every colour in the palette.

type

Either "discrete" (default) to return the curated colours as they are, or "continuous" to interpolate n colours across the palette with grDevices::colorRampPalette().

strict

Logical. For discrete palettes, error when n exceeds the number of curated colours (default). If FALSE, interpolate to n colours instead.

sort

Logical. If TRUE, order the colours from darkest to lightest (by CIE lightness) before selecting or interpolating. Useful when a palette is used as a sequential gradient; see tf_find_palettes().

medium

Which version of the character to use: "toy" (default), "cartoon", "comic" or "g2". See tf_media(). Errors with a pointer to the wishlist if the character has no palette in that medium.

Value

A character vector of hex colours with class "tf_palette", which has a print method that draws the swatches.

Examples

tf_palette("optimus_prime")
#> Transformers palette 'optimus_prime' (5 colours, toy)
#> Autobot: Optimus Prime
#> #D0202A #1F3E8F #B8BABF #F2D23C #2D2D2D

tf_palette("optimus_prime", medium = "cartoon")
#> Transformers palette 'optimus_prime_cartoon' (5 colours, cartoon)
#> Autobot: Optimus Prime
#> #D9262C #2244A0 #A9AEB3 #8FCBE8 #4A4F55

tf_palette("Megatron", 3, medium = "comic")
#> Transformers palette 'megatron_comic' (3 colours, comic)
#> Decepticon: Megatron
#> #B9BDC2 #5E6368 #2B2B2B

tf_palette("devastator", medium = "g2")
#> Transformers palette 'devastator_g2' (5 colours, g2)
#> Decepticon / Constructicons: Devastator
#> #F2D21E #6E3FA3 #B5B8BD #262626 #F07C1E

tf_palette("devastator", 12, type = "continuous")
#> Transformers palette 'devastator' (12 colours, toy)
#> Decepticon / Constructicons: Devastator
#> #3FA23F #507D63 #615987 #7449A5 #8E76AE #A8A2B8 #9B9DA1 #67686A #323333 #5B502B #A28933 #E9C23B

tf_palette("hot_spot", 12, type = "continuous", sort = TRUE)
#> Transformers palette 'hot_spot' (12 colours, toy)
#> Autobot / Protectobots: Hot Spot
#> #2A2A2A #26395A #22498B #2F51A3 #704173 #B13142 #C73E3F #B3686A #9F9296 #B2B4B6 #D2D3D3 #F2F2F0


# base graphics
barplot(1:5, col = tf_palette("predaking"))
